Changes.note: “Ders nazırı ata” makes the person you choose a ders nazırı in one of this köşk’s medrese-free courses and gives them the course permissions you choose; they work in that course with them at once, and the post and the permissions end together at the end time, if one is given. “İzinleri düzenle” sets the permissions and the end anew; the permissions that stay keep their giver and date. “Görevden al” ends the post and every permission in that course at once; if someone they appointed from the course is still in post, that person has to be dismissed first. You cannot appoint yourself or change your own post (the Medaris başnazımı excepted). Every appointment, change and dismissal is written to the audit log; a dismissed person can be appointed again.
